newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy offers Btps, new 7-yr CCTs at midmonth sale.
newsitem.headline: Italy offers Btps, new 7-yr CCTs at midmonth sale.

text.p: The Italian Treasury said it will offer new seven-year floating rate certificates (CCTs) bearing a first coupon of 3.80 percent at its regular mid-month auction.
This compares with a first coupon of 4.55 percent at the previous auction of October 1, 2003 CCTs. The new CCTs mature on November 1, 2003.
The Treasury said it would issue further tranches of three, five and 10-year fixed rate bonds (BTP).
The Treasury said it would offer:

* first tranche 1/11/96 7-yr CCTs paying an initial 3.80 pct coupon. The Treasury the new coupon had a spread of 0.15 percent over the yield of six-month short-term bills (Bots) compared with a 0.3 percent spread previously.
* seventh tranche 1/10/99 3-yr BTPs paying a 7.50 percent coupon.
* seventh tranche 15/09/01 5-yr BTPs paying 7.75 percent coupon.
* third tranche 1/11/06 10-yr BTP paying a 7.75 percent coupon.
The amount of paper offered will be announced on November 12.
Subscriptions for the CCT and 10-year BTP auctions close at 1200 GMT on November 15.
Subscriptions for the three and five year BTP auctions close at 1200 GMT on November 18.
